test_TaskTest_test_run: test the TaskTest class and its test_run method to run VISSL training tasks from config files
run_train_main: run the train_main function from vissl.engines.train to execute VISSL training with a given config
create_SSLHydraConfig: create an SSLHydraConfig instance from config file paths using SSLHydraConfig.from_configs
convert_to_attrdict: convert a Hydra config dict to an AttrDict using convert_to_attrdict for attribute-style access
get_checkpoint_folder: get the checkpoint folder path from a VISSL config using get_checkpoint_folder
